name: google_qa_answer_type_reason_explanation
description:
Given a question and an answer (from the Crowdsource team at Google) as well as an additional
    category feature, predict the (subjective) type of the answer in relation to the question. Representing
    a predominantly NLP task that requires deep language understanding (though the most accurate
    models must also consider the category), this dataset stems from a 2019 Kaggle competition:
    https://www.kaggle.com/c/google-quest-challenge
  
 Dataset found from the paper: Benchmarking multimodal automl for tabular data with text fields. arXiv preprint arXiv:2111.02705.
creator: Xingjian Shi, Jonas Mueller, Nick Erickson, Mu Li, Alexander J. Smola
citation: Shi, X., Mueller, J., Erickson, N., Li, M., & Smola, A. J. (2021). Benchmarking multimodal automl for tabular data with text fields. arXiv preprint arXiv:2111.02705.
